name: cx-goal-one-rule
task: Open the door and then pick up the box in the other room, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) with the hard Existence(target_picked_up) captures 'open the door and then pick up the box'. door_open is forced by that chain, so it needs no Existence of its own. The soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed': key_lost already includes the door-closed condition, so the plain Absence template is correct. No clause is redundant or added.

texts: Open the door before picking up the target box: the box pickup must come after the door is opened.
Pick up the mission's target box in the other room; this is the required final goal.
Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.
